scope: Given an actual algebraic cycle, construct its topological fundamental-chain presentation using imported triangulation and cycle-class facts. No generation of algebraic support from arbitrary Hodge data is claimed.

objects.Z: An independently supplied codimension-p rational algebraic cycle on smooth projective X of complex dimension d.
objects.P_alg: Z together with compatible finite triangulation, complex orientations, rational multiplicities and the inclusion into X.
objects.P_top: Finite oriented rational simplicial chains in a triangulation of X, retaining their actual maps into X but not asserting algebraic support.
objects.C: C_{2(d-p)}(X,Q), with its simplicial boundary and subdivision/comparison data.
objects.H: H_{2(d-p)}(X,Q), identified by Poincare duality with H^{2p}(X,Q).

maps.meaning: Read the supplied actual algebraic cycle, not just an algebraic label.
Oriented fundamental chain, extended rationally over cycle components.
Retain the mapped chain while forgetting algebraic-support evidence.
Quotient by boundaries; packet chain choices need not be recoverable.

necessity_lemma: Every supplied algebraic cycle has a closed oriented fundamental-chain packet, and PD of its homology class is its cycle class. Compatible subdivisions and chain homotopies preserve that class.
checked_comparison: Explicit simplicial prism: boundary P(c) + P(boundary c) = c_top - c_bottom. General common-refinement existence is imported, not a constructed universal higher witness generator.

positive_example.topological_source: product of two oriented tetrahedral sphere boundaries

negative_example.Z_top: real x-circle in each elliptic factor
negative_example.meaning: Closed triangulated real torus, but alpha has nonzero (2,0) and (0,2) components; not an algebraic divisor.

rejected_candidate.criterion: A rational Hodge class fails algebraicity because it has no finite rational closed oriented face-coherent chain representative.
rejected_candidate.reason: By rational Poincare duality and simplicial homology, every rational cohomology class has such a chain. This property cannot distinguish algebraic from other Hodge classes.

next_requirement: A stronger obstruction must use independently defined algebraic/Hodge-specific data, descend to cohomology, and vanish on all algebraic cycles. Bare face cancellation and an algebraic label cannot supply it.
references: Bochnak, Coste and Roy, Real Algebraic Geometry: semialgebraic triangulation (imported theorem).
Fulton, Intersection Theory: algebraic cycle classes (imported construction).
Hatcher, Algebraic Topology: chain homotopy, cross products and Poincare duality (imported standard theorems).
